# langfuse_organization (Resource)

Create and manage a Langfuse organization using the provider's admin API key. Requires Langfuse Enterprise. Remove the organization's projects before destroying it; Langfuse rejects deletion while projects remain. Import uses the organization ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langfuse_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example Organization"
  metadata = {
    environment = "development"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the organization.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata for the organization as key-value pairs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_organization.example "$ORGANIZATION_ID"
```
